name: The JEETSONS NFT
description:
The JEETSONS NFT Collectible Trading Cards are digital collectibles and community membership assets built on Solana, inspired by sports culture, music, entertainment, gaming, and Web3 creativity.

Each Jeetson NFT serves as a collectible trading card that may provide access to community experiences, digital activations, live events, exclusive content, merchandise opportunities, and future ecosystem features.

The Jeetsons ecosystem is designed to encourage creativity, participation, storytelling, and community engagement through evolving artwork, gamified experiences, and token-gated access.

NFTs within this collection are intended solely for collectible, artistic, entertainment, and community purposes. Ownership of a Jeetson NFT does not represent equity, ownership, profit participation, investment interest, or any expectation of financial return in any entity, business, treasury, or project.

All roadmap features, utilities, experiences, and activations are subject to change, development timelines, technical feasibility, community participation, and applicable laws and regulations.

Welcome to The Jeetsons.
